0.content: Kachina of the Children of Echoes calls Mualani her first good friend. They met when Mualani knocked over Kachina's cake and took her Spiritway-surfing to make up for it, on a day when Kachina's training had gone badly. Mualani worries that Kachina believes the unkind things people say about her, so she praises her to everyone and tells her she is already a great warrior. In 5.0, when Kachina's team abandoned her, Mualani left her own team for Kinich to lead and paired with her. Kachina beat her in their final individual match. When Kachina failed to return from the Night Warden Wars, Mualani was the first to volunteer to go into the Night Kingdom after her.

1.content: Atea was Mualani's neighbour and one of Natlan's most renowned warriors, famous for throwing hot spring parties for "hot spring buddies" who included the Archon. Years ago an Abyssal monster impaled her; she survived, but the corrosion stayed in her body and she could never again soak in the hot springs. She dug artificial springs so others could enjoy them. On the night Mualani earned her Vision, Atea saved her life and called her "a very brave kid".

2.content: Umoja ("unity") is the Ancient Name of the People of the Springs that Mualani inherited. Five hundred years ago it belonged to Tupac, remembered as the "Giant" who saved Natlan. After Mualani and Kachina defeated Comonqui in the Night Kingdom, her Name glowed even though she had not brought it. Tupac's spirit declared that she had fully embodied her Wayob's aspirations and would unite the tribes. His memories flooded her, revealing that the plan to save Natlan began during the cataclysm, and that the Pyro Archon then was Mavuika herself.

3.comment: Mualani: The Leisurely Puffer and the Sharky Surfboard
3.content: The Leisurely Puffer is the watersports shop at the People of the Springs that Mualani runs. It sells swimsuits, floaters, waterskis and her custom surfboards, each in a "lucky" colour or pattern. It began because people copied every piece of gear she modified. It has become a gathering place for watersports fans. Her flagship product is an inflatable swimsuit that turns into a life preserver.

4.content: Mualani begs the reclusive priestess Citlali for travel fortunes, fighting her through the door. Citlali gave in only after Mualani brought food and dangled an advance copy of a new Mirage Warriors volume from her clients at the Yae Publishing House. The fortune was to take the right-hand path at a fork. An eruption had created an unmapped fork inside a volcano, and the advice got her party through safely. Since then Mualani calls her the "coolest elder", brings gifts, and keeps knocking, waking Citlali around eleven in the morning. Citlali complains that Mualani breaks her door, owes her Mora and eats her food, but also brings snacks, so she calls it even.

key: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
5.content: In the 5.0 Pilgrimage, Mualani asked whether the Traveler could join (refused, since Contending Fire comes only from battles between Natlanese) and then teamed with Kachina. In the team round they took Fire Towers, beat a team and the legendary Amuru, and rode a Spiritway back just in time. Close in the rankings, they met in the final individual match; Kachina won with a surprise attack. Mualani accepted it and told Atea later it was not too surprising: Kachina had always been strong.
